text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mwahahahah... Now is the hour! From<n>the
shadows, once again, I get to<n>observe the
precious figures of all my<n>Umas.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Digital, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gahjklf?! O-O-Oguri?! H-have you some<n>business
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've got a somewhat special<n>training session
planned for today. I was<n>looking for someone to
join me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Somewhat special?! Oh, those two wordsring so sweet in my ears! I will burn yourgloriousness into my mind to rememberforever...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to practice my skills on both turf<n>and dirt.
So I was thinking of someone<n>who's learned about
both.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Which made me think, "I should<n>definitely ask
Digital."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Yes, yes, ask Digital! That's a...<n>That's...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?! Th-th-that's me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Do you not want to? I thought you<n>were the
perfect choice...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It isn't that I don't want to! It's simply...<n>the
chances of you asking... I would've<n>expected the
Earth to split in two before<n>that! Eegh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-this isn't good! I think I'm...hyperventilating... Cough!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Not feeling well? Or<n>worse...
are you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I guess that puts a partner run<n>out of the
question. Sorry for bothering<n>you when you're
unwell.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What?! Oguri... looks... disappointed!Because of... me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HWAAAAH! DIGITAN IS<n>RESURRECTED!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! Please, allow me to accompany<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Are you feeling okay now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm in tip-top shape! Upsetting a<n>lovely Uma
is a direct violation of otaku<n>doctrine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I, Digitan, will put my entire heart and<n>soul into
running by your side!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's kind of weird, but I'm glad you've<n>got all
your energy back. I'll see you at<n>the gate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I get to see Oguri running upclose... Her temperature, her breathwork, her oozing emotions... It's sosublime, I could keel over...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But if I'm to become a cornerstone in an<n>Uma's
path to success, then I have no<n>need for
tomorrow!
